200.15.1(1).explanation: An accessible parking space must be at least 5.6 m long and 3.9 m wide, with at least 2.1 m of vertical clearance.

200.15.1(1)~under_appeal.explanation: The version of this rule under appeal sets the same 5.6 m length and 2.1 m vertical clearance but a smaller 3.4 m minimum width for an accessible parking space.

200.15.1(2).explanation: An accessible parking space that sits parallel to the drive aisle it is reached from must be at least 7.1 m long and 2.6 m wide, with at least 2.1 m of vertical clearance.

200.15.1(3).explanation: The full length of an accessible parking space must sit beside a 1.5 m wide barrier-free aisle or path, as shown on the by-law diagrams. We do not check this against your site.

200.15.1(4).explanation: Accessible parking spaces must be the ones closest to a barrier-free building entrance and passenger elevator, and on the shortest barrier-free route from them. We do not check this against your site.

200.15.1(5).explanation: Accessible parking spaces in buildings must each have a clearly marked outlet that can provide Level 2 or higher electric vehicle charging. We do not check this against your plans.
